title: keyboard typeahead in dropdowns
rule: Keyboard typeahead in dropdowns; avoid dropdown when typing is faster (state/country).
pass_when: Dropdowns support typeahead; state/country (typing faster) is not a dropdown.
fail_when: Dropdown with no typeahead, or state/country forced through a dropdown.
overview: Dropdowns need keyboard typeahead; skip dropdown when typing is faster.
apply_when: Using dropdowns, especially long lists like state or country.
not_when: State or country forced through a dropdown with no typeahead.
agent_hint: Add typeahead to dropdowns; avoid dropdown when typing state or country is faster.
description: Dropdowns should support keyboard typeahead so people can jump by typing. Avoid a dropdown when typing is faster, especially for state or country. Pass when dropdowns support typeahead and state or country is not forced through a dropdown. Fail when a dropdown has no typeahead, or state or country is forced through a dropdown despite typing being faster.
do_not_claim: Mobile checkout “open field not iOS picker” as this row (see `nng.open-field-state-and-card-expiry`).
